asset.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: original premium game brand lockup for a midnight website masthead and sign-in card. A NEW DISTINCT logo direction, not an edit or recreation of any previous logo.
Primary request: Design a refined, exceptionally clean typographic identity reading exactly "MY RP". Use highly legible bespoke geometric sans-serif uppercase lettering with strong simple shapes and an understated contemporary editorial/game identity. A small simple angular road/route monogram sits immediately to the left, made from only two or three decisive clean strokes, with a single route turn suggesting movement through a city. Make this mark restrained and smaller than the wordmark height. The overall design is quiet, confident, luxurious and contemporary, immediately readable at a small website header size.
Composition/framing: A tightly composed horizontal centered logo lockup in a wide landscape canvas, approximately 3:1. Main text occupies most of the horizontal lockup. Clear intentional spacing between MY and RP, compact moderate margins around all sides. Straight-on flat graphic artwork, no perspective or scene.
Color palette: A completely solid uniform opaque background in exact midnight navy #0a0e17 across the full canvas. Lettering solid ivory #f5f3ec. Small route monogram uses restrained warm amber #ffb052 and at most one cobalt #5d8cff accent stroke. Crisp flat fills and immaculate smooth vector-like edges.
Text (verbatim): "MY RP". Spell M Y, space, R P. This is the only text.
Constraints: NOT transparent; opaque RGB-style background, uniform edge to edge. This is flat graphic brand artwork, not photography, not 3D. Use a distinct typographic family with clean conventional R and P counters and simple readable Y geometry. No distress, no texture, no grit, no stray pixels, no rough edges, no gradients, no metallic finish, no bevels, no shadows, no glow. No shields, crowns, badges, slogans, extra letters, mockups, watermarks or copied franchise identity.
